Answers.Answer: If you're experiencing trouble booking tickets, please ensure your payment information is up to date and that you've selected the correct showtime and seat.
If your payment isn't going through, check if your card is valid and has sufficient funds. For persistent issues, please try an alternative payment method.
You can cancel your booking from your account under Cancel Booking in Menu. Refunds are processed according to our refund policy.
For the latest Showtime and any unexpected schedule changes, please visit our showtime page.
Our Membership program offers discounts and more.
Your feedback is important to us! Please submit it through the feedback form
To access member-exclusive content, please ensure you are logged in with your member account.

Age restrictions are based on the content rating of each film. You can find this information on the film’s detail page on our website. Please ensure that you meet the age requirement before booking tickeet.
You can update your contact information through your profile settings on our website.
